text: Materials Science and Engineering (Professional Code: 080401) is an engineering discipline that focuses on material design, preparation, performance optimization and application, and belongs to the category of materials. This major focuses on the relationship between the composition, structure, preparation process and performance of various materials such as metals, ceramics, polymers and composite materials, aiming to cultivate compound talents capable of solving complex engineering problems in the field of materials. As the creator of "industrial food", materials Science and Engineering serves as the fundamental support for high-tech industries such as aerospace, electronic information, energy, and healthcare.
